sloka: तस्मिन् काले हि कौसल्या तस्थावामीलितेक्षणा ।सुमित्रयान्वास्यमाना सीतया लक्ष्मणेन च ॥२-४-३२॥
transliteration: tasmin kāle hi kausalyā tasthāvāmīlitekṣaṇā ।sumitrayānvāsyamānā sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca ॥2-4-32॥

translations.english: At that moment Kausalya was meditating with her eyes halfclosed. Sumitra, Lakshmana and Sita were attending on her.
